seatbelt: Keep your seatbelt fastened when seated.

smooth.label: Smooth
smooth.summary: You may barely notice any movement.
smooth.detail: A drink resting on your tray usually stays still.

light.label: Light
light.summary: Small bumps may give your seatbelt a gentle tug.
light.detail: A drink might ripple. Walking is usually easy and cabin service can often continue.

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.summary: Firmer jolts can press you against your seatbelt.
moderate.detail: Loose items can shift. Walking and serving drinks become difficult, and the crew may switch on the seatbelt sign.

severe.label: Severe
severe.summary: Strong jolts can push you hard against your seatbelt.
severe.detail: Walking becomes impossible and loose items can be tossed about. Severe encounters are uncommon on airliners, and crews try to avoid them.

unavailable.label: Unavailable
unavailable.summary: There is too little forecast data to say how this section may feel.
unavailable.detail: You may see this beyond the weather grid or its time window.

unreported.label: Unreported
unreported.summary: This observation does not say how bumpy the air felt.
unreported.detail: The cabin conditions at that point are unknown.
